cells.name: Group similar customer requests
faces: Cluster the week's requests so the same answer is written once

cells.name: Prepare a clear answer for a common question
faces: Cite the note it came from

cells.name: Escalate what support cannot close
faces: Hand the request on with what was already tried attached

findings.title: Grouping and answering are effectively one step
findings.detail: They ran within a minute of each other in 96% of the window, and never apart by more than an hour.
findings.action: Treat them as one procedure when either is changed.

findings.title: Escalation is the only cell a second person approves
findings.detail: Everything else is approved by its author, so escalation is the only place a second reader sees the work.
findings.action: Decide whether that is intended before adding a fourth cell.

limits: No message content is read. Coupling comes from what the cells declare and when they ran.

memories.subject: support
memories.fact: An answer cites the note it came from or it does not go out.

memories.subject: support
memories.fact: Escalations carry what was already tried.
